name: 66085 · Stilwell, KS
findings: ZIP 66085 (Stilwell) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66085 (Stilwell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66085 (Stilwell) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
